description: Home: the whole stack's CPU and memory, in the namespaces asked for: the pods that hold on to a node (not those that finished), added up, by namespace and by node, and how the totals went.

metrics.description: Whether the cluster has a metrics API (else nothing is used).

pods.description: How many pods are added up.

nodes.description: Each node's part (against its own allocatable).

history.description: The totals each time they were read, oldest first, kept in the host's memory.

every.description: How often a head reads them, in seconds.

minutes.description: How far back the history goes, in minutes.
